claims.claim_text: The indexed Chester L Cooper is high-confidence match Chester Lawrence Cooper, who served with the Army in India and then with OSS in China.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Chester Lawrence Cooper was born in Boston
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Two independent reputable biographies supply the full name, matching 1917-2005 life dates, NYU degrees, Army service, and OSS work in China.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The uncommon exact first name, surname, and middle initial, the full Lawrence expansion, and explicit OSS-in-China chronology align across both sources. The index identifier conflicts with the Army merged file and therefore remains a documented warning rather than supporting evidence.
claims.temporal_assessment: Both sources place Army and OSS service during World War II after 1941 education.
claims.match_notes: High-confidence identity despite a material identifier conflict. Box 142 must resolve whether the printed value is erroneous or belongs to a different archival context; no Army-file facts are borrowed from the one-digit-different exact-name row.
